intent.raw_query: Nepal trekking Annapurna, $2000 solo, October 2026, 14 days

experiences.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic multi-day trek to Annapurna Base Camp at 4,130m. Trek through rhododendron forests, terraced fields, and glacial moraines while enjoying panoramic views of Annapurna I, Machapuchare, and Hiunchuli. The trail passes through traditional Gurung villages offering authentic cultural immersion alongside breathtaking Himalayan scenery.
experiences.location: Annapurna Sanctuary, Chhomrong to ABC route

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m for one of Nepal's most celebrated sunrise spectacles. Watch golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges in a stunning 180-degree panorama. The relatively short but rewarding hike takes about 1.5 hours from Ghorepani and is accessible to most fitness levels.

experiences.name: Mardi Himal Trek
experiences.description: Explore the lesser-trodden Mardi Himal trail, a hidden gem offering solitude and raw Himalayan beauty without the crowds of the main ABC route. Trek through dense forests of oak and rhododendron, alpine meadows, and rocky ridgelines leading to Mardi Himal Base Camp at 4,500m with jaw-dropping close-up views of Machapuchare (Fishtail Mountain).
experiences.location: Mardi Himal, Lwang Ghalel to High Camp route

experiences.name: Gurung Village Cultural Walk & Dal Bhat Experience
experiences.description: Spend a half-day exploring the traditional Gurung village of Ghandruk, one of the largest and best-preserved Gurung settlements in Nepal. Visit the Gurung Museum, observe traditional stone-paved alleyways, and share a home-cooked Dal Bhat meal with a local family. Learn about Gurung customs, shamanic traditions, and the history of Gurkha soldiers while surrounded by stunning mountain backdrops.

experiences.name: Jhinu Danda Natural Hot Springs Soak
experiences.description: After days of strenuous trekking, descend to the natural hot springs at Jhinu Danda perched above the Modi Khola river gorge. Soak tired muscles in geothermally heated mineral pools while listening to the roaring river below and gazing at forested hillsides. A perfect mid-trek recovery experience that combines nature, relaxation, and the raw beauty of the Annapurna foothills.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Annapurna, Nepal
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so no afternoon activities scheduled
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 22:30. Clear immigration, collect baggage, and arrange a pre-booked budget taxi or airport bus to your accommodation. Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort, freshen up, and get a good night's rest to prepare for the trek ahead.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight or at airport)
meals.lunch: Not applicable (in-flight or at airport)
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night snack from a 24-hour airport kiosk or a small dal bhat from a local eatery near the hotel if available (~NPR 200-400)

day_by_day.notes: Keep your first night simple. Exchange a small amount of currency at the airport (USD 50-100) for immediate expenses. Save major currency exchange for Kathmandu's Thamel area for better rates. Rest is your priority tonight.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up and enjoy a budget breakfast at the hotel or a nearby local teahouse. Spend the morning exploring Thamel neighborhood on foot — browse trekking gear shops for any last-minute supplies (poles, gloves, layers) at affordable prices. Purchase or rent essential trekking gear if needed.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Annapurna Conservation Area Project (ACAP) office to obtain your ACAP permit (~NPR 3,000) and TIMS card (~NPR 2,000) — both mandatory for the Annapurna trek. Head to Swayambhunath Stupa (Monkey Temple) for a short cultural visit with panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley (~NPR 200 entry for foreigners).
day_by_day.evening: Return to Thamel for a relaxed evening. Walk through the lively streets, explore local handicraft stalls, and enjoy dinner at a budget Nepali restaurant. Early bedtime to prepare for the journey to Pokhara tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Local teahouse near hotel — eggs, toast, and tea (~NPR 300-500)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at a local Thamel restaurant (~NPR 350-500)
meals.dinner: Momo (dumplings) and thukpa (noodle soup) at a budget Thamel eatery (~NPR 400-600)

day_by_day.notes: Double-check your trekking permit requirements. Bring passport-sized photos (4-6 copies) for permits. Pack light — budget teahouses on the trail have limited storage. A 40-50L backpack is ideal.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning departure from Kathmandu to Pokhara by tourist bus from the Thamel bus station (departs ~7:00-8:00 AM). The journey takes approximately 6-7 hours through scenic mountain roads. Enjoy views of terraced hillsides and river valleys along the way. Budget bus ticket costs approximately NPR 600-800.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Pokhara around 2:00-3:00 PM. Check in to a budget guesthouse near Lakeside area (NPR 500-800/night for a basic room). Take a leisurely stroll along Phewa Lake's Lakeside promenade, enjoy the serene views of the Annapurna range reflecting on the lake, and visit the local market to stock up on trail snacks.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the Lakeside (Baidam) area on foot. Browse trekking shops for any final gear needs. Watch the sunset over Phewa Lake from the lakeside promenade — a stunning free experience. Enjoy dinner at one of the many budget restaurants lining the lake.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast before bus departure — bread, eggs, and tea (~NPR 300)
meals.lunch: Packed snacks on the bus or a quick stop at a roadside dhaba (~NPR 200-300)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or pasta at a Lakeside budget restaurant (~NPR 400-600)

day_by_day.notes: Book your bus ticket the evening before from Thamel. Sit on the right side of the bus for better mountain views. Pokhara's Lakeside area is the trekking hub — confirm your trekking route and book a local guide if desired (NPR 1,500-2,000/day).

day_by_day.morning: Early wake-up at 5:30 AM to catch a sunrise view of the Annapurna and Machapuchare (Fishtail) peaks from the Pokhara lakeside — completely free and absolutely breathtaking. After sunrise, enjoy a hearty breakfast and take a local bus or shared jeep from Pokhara to Nayapul (approximately 1.5-2 hours, ~NPR 200-300). Begin the trek from Nayapul toward Tikhedhunga.
day_by_day.afternoon: Trek from Nayapul (1,070m) through Birethanti (1,025m) — register your permits at the ACAP checkpoint here — and continue uphill to Tikhedhunga (1,540m). The trail passes through rhododendron forests, suspension bridges over the Modi Khola river, and traditional Gurung villages. Distance: approximately 8-10 km, 3-4 hours of trekking.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tikhedhunga and check in to a basic teahouse (NPR 100-200/night — rooms are often free or very cheap when you eat meals there). Rest tired legs, enjoy the mountain village atmosphere, and interact with fellow trekkers. Stunning views of surrounding peaks at dusk.

meals.breakfast: Full trekker's breakfast in Pokhara — porridge, eggs, toast, and tea (~NPR 400-600)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or noodle soup at a teahouse in Birethanti (~NPR 350-500)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Tikhedhunga teahouse (~NPR 400-500) — the most nutritious and filling budget meal on the trail

day_by_day.notes: October is peak trekking season in Nepal — expect beautiful clear skies and comfortable temperatures. Start trekking early each day to avoid afternoon clouds. Stay hydrated and use water purification tablets or a filter bottle to save money on bottled water (NPR 100-200 per bottle on the trail).

day_by_day.morning: Early start at 6:30 AM from Tikhedhunga. The first major challenge of the day is the famous 3,300+ stone steps ascending from Tikhedhunga to Ulleri (2,073m) — a steep but rewarding 1.5-2 hour climb. Take it slowly, breathe deeply, and enjoy the incredible views that open up as you gain altitude.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Ulleri through Banthanti (2,250m) and Nangethanti to reach Ghorepani (2,874m). The trail passes through magnificent rhododendron and oak forests — in October, the forest is lush and green. Total trekking distance today: approximately 11 km, 5-6 hours. Check in to a teahouse in Ghorepani.
day_by_day.evening: Settle in at Ghorepani — a popular trekking hub with multiple teahouses. Enjoy panoramic views of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna South, and Hiunchuli peaks from the village. Rest well and set an alarm for an early pre-dawn start tomorrow for Poon Hill sunrise.

meals.breakfast: Porridge with honey and tea at Tikhedhunga teahouse (~NPR 300-400)
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or fried rice at Ulleri or Banthanti teahouse (~NPR 350-500)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Ghorepani teahouse (~NPR 450-550) — refills are usually free!

day_by_day.notes: The Tikhedhunga to Ulleri stone staircase is physically demanding. Pace yourself and take breaks. Trekking poles are highly recommended for this section. Ghorepani has reliable teahouses but book ahead during peak season. Temperatures drop significantly at night at this altitude — have warm layers ready.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up at 4:30 AM for the iconic Poon Hill sunrise hike. The climb from Ghorepani to Poon Hill (3,210m) takes approximately 45 minutes on a well-marked trail. Witness one of the most spectacular sunrises in the Himalayas — a 360-degree panorama of Dhaulagiri (8,167m), Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Nilgiri, Machapuchare, and dozens of other peaks glowing golden at dawn. Entry fee: NPR 100. Return to Ghorepani for breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: After breakfast, begin the descent toward Tadapani (2,630m) through dense rhododendron forests. The trail offers continuous mountain views and passes through several small settlements. Distance: approximately 10 km, 4-5 hours of trekking. Arrive at Tadapani and check in to a teahouse.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at Tadapani and enjoy the quieter, less-crowded atmosphere compared to Ghorepani. Tadapani offers excellent views of Annapurna South and Machapuchare at sunset. Chat with other trekkers and share trail stories around the communal dining room.

meals.breakfast: Hot tea or coffee on Poon Hill summit (vendors set up early, ~NPR 100-150), then full breakfast back at Ghorepani teahouse (~NPR 350-500)
meals.lunch: Packed biscuits and snacks on the trail, or stop at a small teahouse between Ghorepani and Tadapani (~NPR 200-350)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or vegetable curry at Tadapani teahouse (~NPR 400-500)

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill is the highlight of the Annapurna circuit for many trekkers. Bring a headlamp for the pre-dawn hike. It can be very cold at the summit — wear all your warm layers. The sunrise experience is absolutely worth the early wake-up. Bring your camera and extra batteries (cold temperatures drain batteries faster).

day_by_day.morning: Depart Tadapani early toward Chhomrong (2,170m), one of the main gateway villages to the Annapurna Sanctuary (ABC). The trail descends steeply through rhododendron and bamboo forests before crossing the Kimrong Khola river and climbing back up to Chhomrong. Distance: approximately 10 km, 4-5 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Chhomrong — a large, well-developed Gurung village with spectacular views of Annapurna South and Machapuchare. Explore the village, visit the local monastery, and enjoy the terraced fields and traditional stone houses. Check your permits at the ACAP checkpoint and check in to a teahouse.
day_by_day.evening: Chhomrong is a great place to rest and acclimatize. Enjoy the stunning sunset views over the Annapurna massif from the village. The village has a few small shops where you can stock up on snacks and supplies for the higher altitude sections ahead.

meals.breakfast: Porridge, eggs, and tea at Tadapani teahouse (~NPR 350-450)
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or dal bhat at a mid-trail teahouse (~NPR 350-500)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat with extra vegetable curry at Chhomrong teahouse (~NPR 450-600)

day_by_day.notes: Chhomrong marks the entry point to the Annapurna Sanctuary trail. Stock up on any supplies here as prices increase significantly at higher altitudes. Water purification is essential from this point onward. The trail from Tadapani to Chhomrong involves significant elevation changes — take your time.

day_by_day.morning: Early departure from Chhomrong, descending the famous Chhomrong stone staircase to the Chhomrong Khola river, then ascending to Sinuwa (2,360m). Continue through bamboo and rhododendron forests to Bamboo (2,310m) and Dovan (2,600m). The trail enters the Annapurna Sanctuary gorge — a dramatic, narrow valley with towering cliffs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Dovan through Himalaya Hotel (2,920m) to Deurali (3,230m). The landscape becomes increasingly dramatic as you enter the high-altitude sanctuary. The trail passes through avalanche zones — stay alert and move quickly through these sections. Check in to a teahouse at Deurali.
day_by_day.evening: At Deurali, you're deep inside the Annapurna Sanctuary with towering peaks on all sides. The atmosphere is remote and awe-inspiring. Rest well, drink plenty of fluids to aid acclimatization, and prepare for the final push to Annapurna Base Camp tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Full breakfast at Chhomrong teahouse (~NPR 400-500)
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or garlic soup at Bamboo or Dovan teahouse (~NPR 400-550) — garlic soup is believed to help with altitude acclimatization
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or pasta at Deurali teahouse (~NPR 500-650) — prices increase with altitude

day_by_day.notes: This is a long and physically demanding day. Start early. The Annapurna Sanctuary gorge is prone to avalanches — always check with local teahouse owners about trail conditions. Do NOT trek through avalanche zones during bad weather or heavy snowfall. Altitude sickness can begin affecting trekkers above 3,000m — watch for symptoms (headache, nausea, dizziness) and descend immediately if severe.

day_by_day.morning: The big day! Depart Deurali at first light (6:00 AM) for Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m). Trek through Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC, 3,700m) — a stunning location with close-up views of the sacred Machapuchare (Fishtail) peak. The final climb from MBC to ABC takes approximately 1.5-2 hours through a glacial moraine landscape.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) — a profound achievement! You are surrounded by a complete amphitheater of 8,000m+ peaks: Annapurna I, Annapurna South, Gangapurna, Glacier Dome, Hiunchuli, and the iconic Machapuchare. Spend the afternoon exploring the base camp area, taking photographs, and soaking in the extraordinary mountain environment.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the spectacular sunset alpenglow on the Annapurna massif from base camp — one of the most memorable experiences in trekking. The peaks turn shades of pink, orange, and red as the sun sets. Temperatures drop sharply at night (-5°C to -15°C in October) — wear all your warm layers and get an early night.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at Deurali before departure — porridge and tea (~NPR 400-500)
meals.lunch: Hot soup and snacks at Machhapuchhre Base Camp teahouse (~NPR 500-650)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or pasta at ABC teahouse (~NPR 600-800) — prices are highest here due to remoteness

day_by_day.notes: THIS IS THE HIGHLIGHT OF THE TRIP. Reaching ABC at 4,130m is a significant physical achievement. Drink 3-4 liters of water throughout the day. Avoid alcohol at high altitude. Symptoms of Acute Mountain Sickness (AMS) include severe headache, vomiting, and confusion — if these occur, descend immediately. October weather is generally excellent with clear skies, but conditions can change rapidly. Celebrate your achievement!

day_by_day.morning: Wake up at 5:00 AM for the magical ABC sunrise — arguably even more spectacular than Poon Hill, as you are completely surrounded by the highest peaks in the world. Watch the first golden light illuminate Annapurna I and the surrounding giants. After sunrise, begin the descent back toward Bamboo or Chhomrong.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend from ABC through MBC, Deurali, Himalaya Hotel, Dovan, and aim to reach Bamboo (2,310m) or Sinuwa (2,360m) by afternoon. Descending is significantly faster than ascending — the return journey from ABC to Bamboo takes approximately 5-6 hours. Enjoy the changing vegetation as you descend back into the bamboo and rhododendron forests.
day_by_day.evening: Check in to a teahouse at Bamboo or Sinuwa. Rest your knees and legs after the long descent. Celebrate your successful ABC trek with fellow trekkers. The lower altitude means warmer temperatures and a much more comfortable night's sleep.

meals.breakfast: Hot tea and light snacks at ABC before departure (~NPR 300-400)
meals.lunch: Noodle soup at a mid-descent teahouse (~NPR 400-500)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Bamboo or Sinuwa teahouse (~NPR 450-550)

day_by_day.notes: Descending is harder on your knees than ascending — use trekking poles and take short steps. Don't rush the descent. Your body needs time to readjust to lower altitude. Drink plenty of fluids. You've accomplished something truly remarkable — savor the feeling!

day_by_day.morning: Continue descent from Bamboo/Sinuwa back to Chhomrong (2,170m), climbing the famous stone staircase from the river back up to the village. Enjoy breakfast in Chhomrong with beautiful views of Annapurna South and Machapuchare. Rest in Chhomrong for a few hours to recover.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depart Chhomrong and trek down toward Jhinu Danda (1,760m), a small village famous for its natural hot springs on the banks of the Modi Khola river. The descent takes approximately 1.5-2 hours. Soak in the natural hot springs — a heavenly reward for tired trekking legs! Entry to the hot springs costs approximately NPR 200-300.
day_by_day.evening: Stay overnight at Jhinu Danda teahouse and enjoy a relaxed evening. The sound of the river, the warmth of the hot springs, and the knowledge that you've completed the ABC trek makes for a very satisfying evening. Early bedtime for the long trek out tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Full breakfast at Chhomrong teahouse — eggs, toast, porridge, and tea (~NPR 400-500)
meals.lunch: Light snacks on the trail between Chhomrong and Jhinu Danda (~NPR 200-300)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or fried rice at Jhinu Danda teahouse (~NPR 400-500)

day_by_day.notes: The Jhinu Danda hot springs are a well-deserved treat after the demanding ABC trek. The springs are open from early morning to evening. The water temperature is naturally warm and soothing for tired muscles. This is a wonderful rest stop before the final descent to Nayapul.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning soak in the hot springs (if you haven't had enough!) before departing Jhinu Danda. Trek down through New Bridge and Kimche village, following the Modi Khola river valley back toward Nayapul. The trail is mostly downhill through terraced farmland and small villages.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Nayapul (1,070m) and take a local bus or shared jeep back to Pokhara (approximately 1.5-2 hours, ~NPR 200-300). Arrive in Pokhara by early afternoon. Check back in to your Lakeside guesthouse, take a hot shower (bliss!), do laundry, and rest.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the completion of your Annapurna Base Camp trek with a well-deserved meal at one of Pokhara's Lakeside restaurants. Enjoy a relaxed evening stroll along Phewa Lake. Treat yourself to a budget massage at one of the many affordable massage parlors in Lakeside (~NPR 800-1,200 for a full body massage).

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at Jhinu Danda before departure (~NPR 300-400)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at a teahouse in New Bridge or along the trail (~NPR 350-450)
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner at a Lakeside restaurant — pizza, pasta, or Nepali thali (~NPR 500-800)

day_by_day.notes: You've completed the Annapurna Base Camp trek — approximately 110 km round trip with over 4,000m of elevation gain! This is a massive achievement. Take time to appreciate what you've accomplished. Check your body for any blisters, muscle soreness, or other issues and treat them appropriately. Rest is essential today.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day in Pokhara. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast at a Lakeside café. Take a relaxing boat ride on Phewa Lake (NPR 500-700 for a rowboat rental for 2 hours) and visit the Tal Barahi Temple located on an island in the middle of the lake (NPR 20 boat fare to the island).
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara (NPR 300 entry) — a fascinating museum dedicated to the history of Himalayan mountaineering, the mountains of Nepal, and the indigenous mountain peoples. Alternatively, hike up to the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) for panoramic views of Pokhara, Phewa Lake, and the Annapurna range (free entry, 30-45 minute hike from lakeside).
day_by_day.evening: Final evening in Pokhara. Stroll through the Lakeside market and pick up souvenirs — handmade thangka paintings, Tibetan jewelry, pashmina scarves, and trekking-themed handicrafts make great budget gifts. Enjoy a final dinner at a Lakeside restaurant with views of the illuminated lake.

meals.breakfast: Pancakes, fresh fruit, and coffee at a Lakeside café (~NPR 400-600)
meals.lunch: Momos and thukpa at a local Pokhara restaurant (~NPR 350-500)
meals.dinner: Nepali set meal (thali) or continental food at a Lakeside restaurant (~NPR 500-700)

day_by_day.notes: Pokhara is a wonderful city to relax in after a demanding trek. The World Peace Pagoda offers some of the best free views in Nepal. October weather in Pokhara is typically clear and sunny — perfect for enjoying the lake and mountain views. Begin packing for the return journey to Kathmandu tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning final sunrise view of the Annapurna range from Pokhara Lakeside — a perfect farewell to the mountains. Enjoy a final breakfast at your favorite Lakeside café. Check out of your guesthouse and take a tourist bus or local bus back to Kathmandu (departs ~7:00-8:00 AM, ~NPR 600-800, approximately 6-7 hours).
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Kathmandu around 2:00-3:00 PM. Check in to a budget guesthouse in Thamel for your final night. Use the afternoon to visit Pashupatinath Temple (NPR 1,000 entry for foreigners) — the most sacred Hindu temple in Nepal, located on the banks of the Bagmati River — or Boudhanath Stupa (NPR 400 entry) — one of the largest Buddhist stupas in the world and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening in Nepal. Return to Thamel for last-minute souvenir shopping — compare prices and bargain respectfully for the best deals. Enjoy a farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant in Thamel with views over the city. Reflect on an incredible 14-day adventure through the Annapurna region. Pack your bags for departure.

meals.breakfast: Final Pokhara breakfast — eggs, toast, fresh juice, and coffee (~NPR 400-600)
meals.lunch: Quick meal on the bus or at a roadside stop (~NPR 200-300)
meals.dinner: Special farewell dinner at a Thamel rooftop restaurant — Nepali cuisine with live music (~NPR 600-900)

day_by_day.notes: This is your final full day in Nepal. Make the most of it! Keep NPR 1,500-2,000 in cash for airport departure tax and any last-minute expenses. Confirm your return flight details and arrange airport transportation in advance. Nepal's Tribhuvan Airport can be busy — arrive at least 3 hours before international departure. Carry trekking memories, photographs, and a heart full of gratitude for this extraordinary Himalayan adventure!

trip_options.title: Classic Annapurna, Nepal Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so Day 1 is purely arrival night
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so Day 1 is purely arrival night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 22:30. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and arrange pre-booked transfer or taxi to your accommodation near the Annapurna region (or overnight in Kathmandu if transfer is not feasible). Check in, freshen up, and rest.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable — in-flight meal
meals.lunch: Not applicable — in-flight meal
meals.dinner: Light snack or dal bhat at a 24-hour hotel restaurant or airport eatery upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange airport pickup in advance. Keep energy bars and water handy after landing. If driving to Pokhara/Annapurna region overnight is not safe, book a Kathmandu guesthouse for the night and travel in the morning.

day_by_day.morning: Transfer from Kathmandu to Pokhara (approximately 6–7 hours by tourist bus or 25-minute flight). Enjoy scenic mountain views en route. Arrive and check in to Aegean Bliss Resort, Annapurna. Freshen up and take a short orientation walk around the resort and lakeside Phewa area.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Lakeside Pokhara (Baidam area) — stroll along Phewa Lake, browse local trekking gear shops, pick up any supplies needed for upcoming treks. Visit the colorful Barahi Temple on the island in Phewa Lake (short boat ride).
day_by_day.evening: Sunset view from the lakeside promenade. Enjoy a relaxed welcome dinner at a lakeside restaurant with views of the Annapurna range.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or quick meal at a Kathmandu café before departure
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or momos at a roadside dhaba en route to Pokhara (mid-range, ~$4–6)
meals.dinner: Dinner at Moondance Restaurant or Caffe Concerto, Pokhara — try Nepali thali or pasta (~$8–12)

day_by_day.notes: Opt for a tourist bus (~$10–15) for a scenic journey or a domestic flight (~$80–100) if budget allows. Book bus tickets in advance during October peak season.

day_by_day.morning: Early rise for sunrise views of the Annapurna and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) peaks from the resort or Sarangkot Hill (30-min drive + short hike). Witness golden light on the Himalayas — one of Nepal's most iconic sights.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara — learn about Himalayan history, climbing expeditions, and local culture. Excellent context before your trekking days ahead.
day_by_day.evening: Explore Pokhara's Old Bazaar for local handicrafts, Tibetan jewelry, and thangka paintings. Enjoy a relaxed evening by the lake.

meals.breakfast: Sarangkot sunrise breakfast at a hilltop café — eggs, toast, and tea with mountain views (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Lunch at OR2K Restaurant — vegetarian mezze or sandwiches (~$7–10)
meals.dinner: Dinner at Busy Bee Café or Pokhara Thakali Kitchen — try Thakali set meal (~$6–9)

day_by_day.notes: Hire a taxi to Sarangkot (~$5–8 one way) and start the hike by 5:00 AM for best sunrise. Bring a warm layer as mornings are cold at altitude in October.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the Poon Hill Trek — Day 1: Drive from Pokhara to Nayapul (1.5 hours), then trek to Tikhedhunga (1,540m). Trail winds through rice terraces, rhododendron forests, and traditional Gurung villages. Trek duration: ~4–5 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Tikhedhunga by early afternoon. Rest, explore the village, and interact with local Gurung families. Visit the old watermill and stone-paved trails.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into a comfortable teahouse/lodge. Enjoy views of the Modi Khola valley. Acclimatize and prepare gear for the next day's steep ascent.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast before departure — eggs, porridge, and tea
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or noodle soup at a teahouse in Birethanti (~$4–6)
meals.dinner: Teahouse dinner in Tikhedhunga — garlic soup, dal bhat, and apple pie (~$6–8)

day_by_day.notes: Carry TIMS card and ACAP permit (obtain in Pokhara, ~$30 total). Pack light for the trek — leave extra luggage at the hotel. Hire a local guide (~$25–30/day) for a richer experience and safety.

day_by_day.morning: Trek Day 2: Tikhedhunga to Ghorepani (2,860m). The most challenging day with 3,400+ stone steps ascending through dense rhododendron and oak forests. Trek duration: ~5–6 hours. Enjoy stunning views opening up as you gain altitude.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Ghorepani by early afternoon. Rest and recover. Explore the village and its panoramic views of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna South, and Hiunchuli peaks.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset over the Annapurna range from the village. Warm up by the teahouse fire with hot lemon tea. Chat with fellow trekkers from around the world.

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast — porridge, eggs, and hot tea before the big climb
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or stop at Ulleri teahouse — ramen noodles or veg fried rice (~$4–5)
meals.dinner: Teahouse dinner in Ghorepani — dal bhat (unlimited refills), garlic soup (~$6–8)

day_by_day.notes: The climb from Tikhedhunga to Ulleri (3,400 steps) is strenuous — pace yourself and take breaks. Stay hydrated. October weather is generally clear and cool, perfect for trekking.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) — 45-minute hike from Ghorepani starting at 5:00 AM. Witness one of Nepal's most spectacular sunrises with 360° panoramic views of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna I, Annapurna South, Machhapuchhre, and dozens of Himalayan peaks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend back to Ghorepani for breakfast, then trek to Tadapani (2,630m) through beautiful rhododendron forest. Trek duration: ~4–5 hours. Tadapani offers excellent views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at Tadapani teahouse. Enjoy the peaceful mountain atmosphere and stunning evening alpenglow on the peaks.

meals.breakfast: Hot tea at Poon Hill viewpoint, then full breakfast at Ghorepani teahouse — eggs, toast, porridge
meals.lunch: Lunch at a teahouse en route to Tadapani — veg noodles or spring rolls (~$4–5)
meals.dinner: Dinner in Tadapani — pasta, dal bhat, or potato dishes (~$6–8)

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill entry fee: ~150 NPR (~$1.25). Bring a headlamp and warm layers for the pre-dawn hike. The rhododendron forest between Ghorepani and Tadapani is stunning even in October.

day_by_day.morning: Trek Day 4: Tadapani to Chhomrong (2,170m). Descend through forest and cross the Kimrong Khola river, then ascend to the beautiful Gurung village of Chhomrong. Trek duration: ~5–6 hours. Excellent views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre throughout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Chhomrong and explore this charming terraced village. Visit the Chhomrong Khola waterfall and interact with local Gurung community. This is the gateway to the Annapurna Sanctuary.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy panoramic sunset views from Chhomrong's terraces. The village offers some of the best views on the entire circuit. Relax at a well-appointed teahouse.

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast in Tadapani — pancakes, eggs, and tea
meals.lunch: Lunch at a teahouse in Kimrong — dal bhat or fried rice (~$4–6)
meals.dinner: Dinner in Chhomrong — try the famous apple brandy and local Gurung dishes (~$7–9)

day_by_day.notes: Chhomrong has better-quality teahouses with hot showers (~$2–3 extra). This is a good rest point. If you wish to extend into the Annapurna Base Camp trek, this is where you commit to 2–3 more days upward.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and acclimatization day in Chhomrong. Morning nature walk through the village's stone-paved lanes and terraced fields. Visit the local monastery and school. Enjoy the peaceful Gurung village atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Optional short hike to a nearby viewpoint above Chhomrong for closer views of Annapurna South (3,091m viewpoint). Alternatively, take a relaxing afternoon by the teahouse reading or journaling.
day_by_day.evening: Cultural evening — ask your teahouse host about local Gurung traditions, music, and history. Enjoy a bonfire evening if available.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely breakfast — French toast, honey, and mountain tea
meals.lunch: Light lunch at teahouse — soup and sandwiches (~$4–5)
meals.dinner: Special dinner in Chhomrong — try yak steak or Nepali thali with local raksi (~$8–10)

day_by_day.notes: Use this rest day to air out gear, recharge camera batteries, and tend to any blisters or minor ailments. Stock up on water purification tablets and snacks for the return trek.

day_by_day.morning: Begin return trek: Chhomrong to Jhinu Danda (1,780m). Descend the famous Chhomrong stone steps back toward the Modi Khola valley. Trek duration: ~3–4 hours. Enjoy lush subtropical vegetation on the descent.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Jhinu Danda and reward yourself with a soak in the famous natural hot springs (Jhinu Hot Springs) along the Modi Khola river — perfect muscle recovery after days of trekking.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at a comfortable teahouse in Jhinu Danda. Enjoy the sound of the river and reflect on the incredible mountain journey.

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast in Chhomrong before departure
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or teahouse stop en route — noodle soup (~$3–5)
meals.dinner: Dinner at Jhinu Danda teahouse — dal bhat, vegetable curry, and fresh ginger tea (~$6–8)

day_by_day.notes: Hot springs entry fee: ~200 NPR (~$1.70). The springs are especially magical in the late afternoon light. Bring a towel and change of clothes.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Jhinu Danda to Nayapul (approximately 4–5 hours) through Modi Khola valley, passing through Syauli Bazaar and Birethanti. Enjoy the contrast of subtropical lowland scenery after days in the high mountains.
day_by_day.afternoon: Reach Nayapul and take a jeep or taxi back to Pokhara (1.5 hours). Check back in to Aegean Bliss Resort. Hot shower, laundry, and genuine rest.
day_by_day.evening: Celebratory dinner at a lakeside restaurant in Pokhara to mark the completion of the Poon Hill/Chhomrong trek. Enjoy a massage at a lakeside spa.

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast in Jhinu Danda before the final descent
meals.lunch: Lunch in Birethanti — dal bhat or momos (~$4–6)
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at Caffe Concerto or Lemon Tree Restaurant, Pokhara — grilled fish, pasta, or Nepali thali (~$10–14)

day_by_day.notes: Book a full-body massage at one of Pokhara's many affordable massage centers (~$15–20 for 60 min) — well-deserved after 7 days of trekking! Rehydrate well tonight.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning at the resort. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely breakfast, and take a gentle walk along Phewa Lake shore. Rent a rowboat on Phewa Lake and paddle toward the Barahi Temple island for peaceful morning reflections.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) — a 45-minute uphill hike or short boat ride + hike from the lakeside. Stunning 360° views of Pokhara, Phewa Lake, and the Annapurna range from the hilltop pagoda.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at the World Peace Pagoda or lakeside. Browse Lakeside market for souvenirs — pashmina shawls, Tibetan singing bowls, and trekking keepsakes.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — continental or Nepali set
meals.lunch: Lunch at a café near the World Peace Pagoda or lakeside — sandwiches and fresh juice (~$5–7)
meals.dinner: Dinner at Pokhara Thakali Kitchen — authentic Thakali cuisine with millet beer (~$7–10)

day_by_day.notes: Boat rental on Phewa Lake costs ~$3–5/hour. The World Peace Pagoda hike takes about 45 minutes one way — wear comfortable shoes. October skies are typically crystal clear for views.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Begnas Lake (18 km east of Pokhara) — a quieter, less-touristed lake surrounded by forested hills. Rent a boat, walk the lakeside trails, and enjoy birdwatching in this serene natural setting. Excellent for nature lovers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hike the Begnas Lake circuit trail through Rupa Lake viewpoints and local farming villages. Spot migratory birds common in October. Return to Pokhara by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Visit Pokhara's Tibetan Refugee Camp at Tashiling — browse handmade Tibetan carpets, jewelry, and crafts. Learn about the Tibetan community's history in Nepal.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast before departure to Begnas Lake
meals.lunch: Packed picnic lunch at Begnas Lake or local teahouse — rice and lentil soup (~$3–5)
meals.dinner: Dinner at Boomerang Restaurant, Pokhara — wood-fired pizza or pasta with lake views (~$9–12)

day_by_day.notes: Hire a taxi to Begnas Lake (~$10–12 one way) or rent a scooter (~$10/day) for flexibility. Begnas is ideal for birdwatching — bring binoculars if available.

day_by_day.morning: Optional adventure morning: Paragliding over Phewa Lake from Sarangkot — one of the world's most scenic paragliding destinations. Tandem flights offer 30-minute soaring experiences above the lake with Annapurna panoramas. Alternatively, sunrise photography hike at Sarangkot.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave and Davis Falls (Patale Chhango) — fascinating natural geological formations near Pokhara. Explore the underground cave system and the dramatic waterfall that disappears underground.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening in Pokhara — lakeside stroll, last-minute shopping, and packing. Enjoy a bonfire or cultural show at a lakeside venue if available.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before paragliding — toast, banana, and tea
meals.lunch: Lunch near Davis Falls area — momos, thukpa, or veg curry (~$5–7)
meals.dinner: Farewell Pokhara dinner at Moondance Restaurant — international menu with Nepali specialties (~$10–15)

day_by_day.notes: Paragliding costs ~$80–100 for a tandem flight (30 min) with reputable companies like Blue Sky Paragliding or Sunrise Paragliding. Book in advance during October peak season. Cave entry: ~$2.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — leisurely breakfast at the resort with one last view of the Annapurna range. Pack and check out. Take a final walk along Phewa Lake shore to soak in the atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer back to Kathmandu (tourist bus ~$10–15 or domestic flight ~$80–100 depending on departure time). If time permits in Kathmandu, visit Thamel for last-minute shopping or Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple) for a final cultural experience.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu. Reflect on 14 incredible days in the Annapurna region — trekking, nature, culture, and Himalayan magic.

meals.breakfast: Full resort farewell breakfast — enjoy your last Himalayan morning meal
meals.lunch: Lunch in Kathmandu Thamel area — try Chez Caroline or OR2K for a final mid-range meal (~$7–10)
meals.dinner: Airport dinner or in-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Confirm return transfer and flight details the night before. Allow 3 hours before international departure for check-in. Purchase any remaining souvenirs at Kathmandu Duty Free or Thamel. Keep small NPR notes for tips to guides, porters, and teahouse staff.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Annapurna, Nepal Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m for one of Nepal's most celebrated sunrise spectacles. Watch golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges in a stunning 180-degree panorama. The relatively short but rewarding hike takes about 1.5 hours from Ghorepani and is accessible to most fitness levels.

experiences.name: Jhinu Danda Natural Hot Springs Soak
experiences.description: After days of strenuous trekking, descend to the natural hot springs at Jhinu Danda perched above the Modi Khola river gorge. Soak tired muscles in geothermally heated mineral pools while listening to the roaring river below and gazing at forested hillsides. A perfect mid-trek recovery experience that combines nature, relaxation, and the raw beauty of the Annapurna foothills.

day_by_day.morning: No morning activities — late night arrival. Rest and settle into Aegean Bliss Resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: No afternoon activities — flight UA arrives at 22:30. Transfer from airport to resort via pre-arranged luxury private vehicle.
day_by_day.evening: Late-night arrival at 22:30. Private airport transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check-in, welcome drink, and light refreshments prepared by resort staff. Brief orientation of resort facilities before retiring for the night.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable — arrival after midnight
meals.lunch: Not applicable — in transit
meals.dinner: Late-night welcome platter and herbal teas arranged by the resort upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Ensure resort is notified of late arrival in advance. Pre-arrange private luxury transfer (SUV or premium van) from Tribhuvan International Airport or Pokhara Airport depending on routing. Keep Day 1 completely relaxed to recover from travel fatigue.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely late breakfast at the resort. Orientation walk around the resort grounds and surrounding Annapurna foothills. Meet your dedicated trek guide for a briefing session on the upcoming 12-day itinerary, gear check, and acclimatization plan.
day_by_day.afternoon: Gentle introductory nature walk through the lower Annapurna Conservation Area trails near Pokhara or the resort vicinity. Explore local flora, terraced farmlands, and panoramic Annapurna and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) mountain views. Visit a nearby viewpoint for first impressions of the Himalayan panorama.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails on the resort terrace with Annapurna range views. Private candlelit welcome dinner at the resort's signature restaurant featuring curated Nepali and continental cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Full gourmet breakfast buffet at the resort — eggs to order, fresh Himalayan honey, local breads, seasonal fruits, and Nepali butter tea or specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Light picnic-style lunch box prepared by resort chef, enjoyed at a scenic viewpoint during the afternoon nature walk
meals.dinner: Multi-course welcome dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's fine dining restaurant — dal bhat royale, slow-cooked lamb sekuwa, and Himalayan herb dessert platter paired with curated wines

day_by_day.notes: Use this day purely for acclimatization and relaxation. Avoid strenuous activity. Hydrate well and begin taking altitude precautions if ascending higher zones in coming days. Confirm all trekking permits (ACAP, TIMS) are in order through the resort concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning yoga and meditation session on the resort's mountain-view deck led by a private instructor. Hearty breakfast followed by departure toward Nayapul or Tikhedhunga — the gateway to the Annapurna Circuit foothills. Begin a moderate half-day hike through rhododendron and oak forests with your private guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking through traditional Gurung and Magar villages. Visit a local village home for a cultural interaction and demonstration of traditional weaving or millet processing. Arrive at a premium teahouse or lodge in Ulleri or Tikhedhunga for afternoon tea and rest.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort via private vehicle. Relaxing hot stone massage at the resort spa. Private dinner on the resort balcony under Himalayan starlight.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — Himalayan grain porridge, fresh fruit platter, Nepali-style eggs, and masala chai
meals.lunch: Gourmet trail lunch at a curated teahouse stop — lentil soup, vegetable momos, and local herbal tea
meals.dinner: Private balcony dinner at resort — slow-roasted chicken with Himalayan spices, seasonal vegetable curry, and cardamom rice pudding

day_by_day.notes: This is the first active trekking day — keep pace moderate and enjoy the scenery. October is peak autumn season in Annapurna, expect clear skies and excellent mountain visibility. Carry resort-prepared trail snacks and a refillable water bottle with purification tablets.

day_by_day.morning: Depart resort early for a full-day trek toward Ghorepani. Trek through dense rhododendron forests, passing through Banthanti and Nangethanti. The trail offers increasingly dramatic views of the Annapurna South and Hiunchuli peaks. Private guide leads the group at a comfortable luxury pace with frequent rest stops.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghorepani village (2,860m) by early afternoon. Check into a premium lodge or pre-booked luxury teahouse accommodation. Explore the village, interact with local Magar community members, and visit the small local monastery. Rest and acclimatize before the next morning's highlight.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset views of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna range from Ghorepani ridge. Warm fireside dinner at the lodge with fellow trekkers. Early bedtime in preparation for the 04:00 pre-dawn wake-up for Poon Hill.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast — energy-rich oats, boiled eggs, whole grain toast, and fresh juice before departure
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet trail lunch consumed at a scenic rest point en route — quinoa salad, protein bars, dried fruits, and thermos of hot soup
meals.dinner: Lodge dinner at Ghorepani — hearty dal bhat, garlic soup, vegetable stir-fry, and warm apple cider

day_by_day.notes: Altitude increases to 2,860m at Ghorepani — stay well hydrated and avoid alcohol. The resort will have arranged premium lodge accommodation in advance. Carry warm layers as temperatures drop significantly at night. Set multiple alarms for the 04:00 Poon Hill wake-up call.

day_by_day.morning: POON HILL SUNRISE HIKE: Wake at 04:00 for the iconic pre-dawn ascent to Poon Hill (3,210m). Hike approximately 1.5 hours by torchlight through forest trails. Witness one of Nepal's most celebrated sunrises — a breathtaking 360-degree panorama of Dhaulagiri (8,167m), Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Machhapuchhre, and over a dozen Himalayan peaks bathed in alpenglow. Private guide provides expert mountain identification and photography assistance.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend back to Ghorepani for a late breakfast. Continue trekking downward toward Tadapani through pristine rhododendron forests. Arrive at Tadapani for a rest stop and lunch with sweeping valley views.
day_by_day.evening: Reach Chhomrong village (1,951m) — a charming terraced village above the Modi Khola river valley. Check into premium lodge accommodation. Enjoy the warm village atmosphere, local craft shops, and a relaxed dinner.

meals.breakfast: Pre-hike: hot tea and energy bars at 04:00 before Poon Hill ascent. Post-hike: full cooked breakfast at Ghorepani lodge — pancakes, eggs, porridge, and fresh juice
meals.lunch: Warm lunch at Tadapani teahouse — noodle soup, vegetable fried rice, and ginger lemon honey tea
meals.dinner: Dinner at Chhomrong lodge — Nepali set meal with locally sourced vegetables, chicken curry, and homemade yogurt

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill is the single most iconic experience of this itinerary — weather in October is typically excellent with near-guaranteed clear views. Bring a warm down jacket, gloves, and a good headlamp. A private guide ensures priority positioning at the viewpoint. This is a long and rewarding day — rest well afterward.

day_by_day.morning: Morning hike from Chhomrong toward the Annapurna Sanctuary trail. Trek through Sinuwa and Bamboo zone, entering the dramatically narrowing Modi Khola gorge. Towering walls of Hiunchuli and Machhapuchhre frame the trail as the landscape transitions into sub-alpine terrain.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue ascending through Dovan and Himalayan (Hinku Cave) rest stops. Arrive at Deurali (3,230m) for afternoon tea and rest. The surrounding terrain becomes increasingly dramatic with glacial moraines and high alpine vegetation.
day_by_day.evening: Reach Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC) at 3,700m for overnight stay at the best available lodge. Spectacular evening views of the sacred Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) peak towering directly above. Early dinner and rest — altitude management is key.

meals.breakfast: Lodge breakfast at Chhomrong — Tibetan bread with honey and butter, scrambled eggs, and masala tea
meals.lunch: Trail lunch at Deurali — hot tomato soup, pasta, and energy snacks
meals.dinner: Dinner at MBC lodge — garlic soup (altitude remedy), dal bhat, mixed vegetable curry, and herbal tea

day_by_day.notes: Altitude rises significantly today to 3,700m. Acclimatization symptoms such as mild headache or breathlessness are normal. Drink 3-4 liters of water. Avoid sleeping pills and alcohol. The resort doctor or guide should monitor all party members. Garlic soup is a local remedy for altitude sickness and is highly recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning rise for sunrise at Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) at 4,130m — the crown jewel of the entire trek. A 1.5-hour final ascent through glacial terrain leads to the sacred amphitheater surrounded by eight Himalayan giants: Annapurna I, II, III, IV, South, Gangapurna, Hiunchuli, and Machhapuchhre. An awe-inspiring, life-defining moment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the morning exploring ABC, taking photographs, and absorbing the profound silence of the high Himalayan world. Begin descent back toward MBC and continue down to Deurali for lunch. Descend further to Himalayan hotel for the night.
day_by_day.evening: Comfortable lodge stay at Himalayan hotel. Celebratory dinner to mark reaching ABC. Share stories with fellow trekkers around the lodge hearth.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at MBC before ABC ascent — energy bars, hot tea, and biscuits. Full breakfast upon return to MBC.
meals.lunch: Warm lunch at Deurali on descent — lentil soup, fried rice, and apple juice
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at Himalayan hotel — special lodge menu with pasta, vegetable curry, and chocolate cake if available

day_by_day.notes: ABC at 4,130m is the highest point of this itinerary. October typically offers crystal-clear conditions with minimal cloud cover — ideal for photography. Allow ample time at the summit amphitheater. The descent begins the return journey. Trekking poles are highly recommended for knee support on descent.

day_by_day.morning: Continue descent from Himalayan hotel through Bamboo and Sinuwa zones. The trail winds back through lush forest with the sounds of the Modi Khola river below. A longer but rewarding descent day with increasingly warmer temperatures and richer vegetation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive back at Chhomrong village for lunch. Take a different trail variation toward New Bridge and Jhinu Danda — the famous hot springs village perched above the Modi Khola river.
day_by_day.evening: JHINU DANDA HOT SPRINGS: Descend to the natural hot springs at Jhinu Danda for a deeply restorative soak in the geothermal pools overlooking the rushing Modi Khola river. After days of high-altitude trekking, this is an extraordinary natural reward. Overnight at premium Jhinu Danda lodge.

meals.breakfast: Early lodge breakfast — oatmeal, eggs, and hot lemon ginger tea
meals.lunch: Lunch at Chhomrong — dal bhat with seasonal vegetables and buttermilk
meals.dinner: Relaxed dinner at Jhinu Danda lodge post hot springs soak — grilled trout, roasted potatoes, and warm spiced wine or herbal tea

day_by_day.notes: The Jhinu Danda hot springs are one of the most beloved experiences in the Annapurna region — a perfect physical and mental reset after reaching ABC. The springs are at their best in the late afternoon golden hour. Bring a swimsuit, towel, and flip-flops. The lodge here is rustic but charming — manage luxury expectations relative to lower-altitude resort standards.

day_by_day.morning: Morning soak at the hot springs if time allows before breakfast. Begin trekking out from Jhinu Danda toward Nayapul via Birethanti. The trail descends through terraced fields, suspension bridges, and traditional Gurung villages with warm valley temperatures.
day_by_day.afternoon: Reach Nayapul and board pre-arranged private luxury vehicle back to Pokhara. Arrive in Pokhara lakeside area by early afternoon. Check back into Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy the comfort of luxury accommodation after days on the trail. Long hot shower, resort spa session, and complete relaxation.
day_by_day.evening: Lakeside dinner at one of Pokhara's finest restaurants — stunning views of Phewa Lake and the Annapurna range at dusk. Celebrate the successful completion of the Annapurna Sanctuary trek.

meals.breakfast: Lodge breakfast at Jhinu Danda — pancakes, fresh fruit, and black tea
meals.lunch: Lunch at Birethanti or en route — local thali set with rice, lentils, and pickles
meals.dinner: Premium lakeside dinner at a top Pokhara restaurant (e.g., Moondance Restaurant or Caffe Concerto) — continental and Nepali fusion cuisine with Phewa Lake views

day_by_day.notes: This is a transition day back to luxury comfort. The contrast between rustic lodge life and resort luxury is deeply satisfying. Book a resort spa treatment in advance for the afternoon. Celebrate the trek completion with the team — tip your guide and porters generously.

day_by_day.morning: Full resort rest and recovery morning. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely gourmet breakfast, and indulge in a full-body deep tissue massage at the resort spa. Optional: gentle lakeside walk along Phewa Lake's northern shore.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private boat ride on Phewa Lake to Tal Barahi Temple — a small island temple dedicated to the goddess Barahi. Explore the colorful temple and enjoy the serene lake surrounded by Annapurna reflections. Return to shore for a lakeside café experience.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset Paragliding over Pokhara Valley (optional premium experience) — launch from Sarangkot Hill for a 30-minute tandem paragliding flight over Phewa Lake with panoramic Himalayan views. Alternatively, sunset cocktails at Sarangkot viewpoint. Elegant dinner at resort.

meals.breakfast: Luxurious resort breakfast — full buffet with Eggs Benedict, smoked salmon, artisan pastries, fresh juices, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Light lakeside lunch at a premium café — club sandwich, Caesar salad, and fresh lemonade
meals.dinner: Fine dining dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — seven-course tasting menu with Himalayan-inspired dishes and wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: This is a pure luxury recovery day. October weather in Pokhara is ideal for paragliding with clear skies and stable thermals. Book paragliding in advance through the resort concierge. Phewa Lake boat rides are best in the morning when the lake is calm and mountain reflections are sharpest.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise helicopter tour over the Annapurna range — a premium exclusive experience offering aerial views of Annapurna I, Machhapuchhre, Dhaulagiri, and the entire Sanctuary region just trekked. Land briefly at a high-altitude viewpoint for photographs before returning to Pokhara. A truly extraordinary perspective on the mountains.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara — the world's finest museum dedicated to the Himalayas, mountaineering history, and Nepali mountain culture. Private guided tour with expert curator. Explore exhibits on all 14 eight-thousanders and the legends of Himalayan exploration.
day_by_day.evening: Authentic Newari cultural dinner experience — private arrangement through resort for a traditional Newari feast with cultural performances including Gurung and Tharu dance. Served in a heritage setting with brass utensils and traditional seating.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before helicopter departure — fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, and green tea
meals.lunch: Gourmet lunch at a premium Pokhara restaurant after museum visit — wood-fired pizza, fresh pasta, and imported wine
meals.dinner: Private Newari cultural dinner — beaten rice (chiura), black lentil soup, roasted meat, fermented vegetables, and local rice wine (tongba)

day_by_day.notes: The helicopter tour is a premium highlight — book well in advance as slots are limited. October is peak season and helicopters fill quickly. The International Mountain Museum is genuinely world-class and provides deep context for the trekking experience just completed. Allocate at least 2-3 hours for the museum.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Ghandruk village — one of the most beautiful and culturally rich Gurung villages in the Annapurna foothills. Drive to Kimche and hike up to Ghandruk (1,940m) through terraced fields and rhododendron forests. Explore the Gurung Museum and traditional stone-paved village lanes with panoramic Annapurna South views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Guided village tour of Ghandruk with a local Gurung cultural expert. Visit a traditional Gurung home, learn about the legendary Gurkha soldier heritage, and explore the village gompa (monastery). Enjoy afternoon tea with a local family — a genuine cultural immersion experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Pokhara by late afternoon. Relaxing evening at the resort spa — aromatherapy treatment or Himalayan salt scrub. Romantic candlelit dinner at the resort's beachfront dining area by Phewa Lake.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast before departure — eggs to order, granola, fresh mountain honey, and masala chai
meals.lunch: Traditional Gurung meal in Ghandruk — local thali with maize bread (dhido), nettle soup, fermented radish, and buttermilk
meals.dinner: Beachfront candlelit dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — fresh lake fish, Himalayan herb risotto, and mango kulfi dessert

day_by_day.notes: Ghandruk is approximately 1.5 hours from Pokhara by road plus 1 hour hike. Arrange private vehicle through resort. The Gurung Museum in Ghandruk is small but fascinating. October light in the afternoon is golden and perfect for photography of Annapurna South from the village. Wear comfortable walking shoes.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise visit to Sarangkot Viewpoint (1,592m) — a classic Pokhara experience with a panoramic 180-degree view of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges at dawn. Private vehicle and guide arranged by resort. Return for a leisurely resort breakfast. Morning at leisure — final resort spa session, swimming pool, or journaling.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Pokhara's Old Bazaar and Bindhyabasini Temple area — a vibrant mix of traditional Newari architecture, local markets, and religious sites. Private guided shopping tour for authentic Nepali crafts, pashmina shawls, Thangka paintings, singing bowls, and trekking memorabilia. Visit a premium handicraft store for high-quality souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at Pokhara's most prestigious fine dining establishment — curated multi-course meal celebrating the entire journey. Toast to the Himalayas with champagne or premium Nepali wine. Return to resort for final night of luxury accommodation.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-sunrise snack before Sarangkot departure. Full resort breakfast on return — French toast, smoked salmon, fresh juices, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Premium lakeside lunch at a top Pokhara restaurant — grilled Himalayan trout, roasted vegetables, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner at a top-tier Pokhara restaurant — seven-course Nepali-continental fusion tasting menu with sommelier-selected wine pairing and Himalayan panorama views

day_by_day.notes: Sarangkot sunrise is best experienced in October with near-guaranteed clear skies — depart resort by 05:30 to arrive before dawn. The Old Bazaar shopping is best in the afternoon when all shops are open. Budget extra time and spend generously at authentic craft cooperatives that support local artisans. Pack purchases carefully for the return flight.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise from the resort terrace with a cup of Himalayan tea — a quiet, reflective farewell to the Annapurna range. Leisurely checkout breakfast at the resort. Final spa treatment or pool session if time permits. Pack and prepare for departure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury transfer to Pokhara Airport or Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu (depending on routing). En route, optional brief stop at a final viewpoint or local market. Airport lounge access arranged through premium concierge service.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Nepal. Reflect on 14 extraordinary days in the Annapurna region — from the sacred amphitheater of ABC to the healing waters of Jhinu Danda, the golden sunrise at Poon Hill, helicopter flights over the Himalaya, and the warmth of Gurung culture. The mountains will call you back.

meals.breakfast: Grand final breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — full luxury buffet with all favorites, freshly baked pastries, Himalayan honey, and a farewell glass of fresh pomegranate juice
meals.lunch: Light airport lunch or premium airport lounge dining — sandwiches, salads, and fresh fruit
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or airport restaurant meal depending on departure schedule

day_by_day.notes: Confirm checkout time with resort and arrange luggage handling well in advance. Allow extra time for airport transfer — Nepali roads can be unpredictable. Ensure all trekking permits, receipts, and documentation are collected as souvenirs. Tip all resort staff, guides, and drivers generously — they have been integral to this extraordinary journey. Minimum 3 hours before international departure recommended.
